blocks.x: Well, I say we, unless you have any more, we could uh, break for today. What do you think?
Unless you’ve got some more steam and want to keep going.
No, I think that’s a good day’s work, don’t you think? [Ken Kimery] : Sure.
What do we got, a couple hours? [KK]: Yep. [Recording stopped] [END TRACK 2 CD 2 BEGIN TRACK 3 CD 2]
Did you have breakfast at Molly’s?
No, we had breakfast at the hotel, just a little bit, a little, but uh …
Well, we’ll be ready for lunch.
Oh, yes. Well, here we are again with Phil Woods, June 23rd, 2010.
Third day of summer. [NM]: … as part of the Smithsonian. Yes, third day of summer …
Time flies. [NM]: Well Phil, I wanted to go back to the sixties for maybe just one good story.
